items.title: Make the registered rollout cohort preserve each nested reviewer actor under a canonical parent actor
items.context: The parent writer sets PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT=acceptance-rollout-verifier while the nested CLI helper currently writes only LATTICE_AGENT=<lane>; canonical precedence hides the lane. Fix the child boundary without relaxing the dispatch mutation resolver or registering a verifier identity as a reviewer.

items.title: Add a production-writer regression for canonical-parent and reviewer-child actor propagation
items.context: The existing cohort smoke runs directly and misses the production handler overlay. Exercise acceptance_rollout_report through the handler/CLI with the registered real cohort, prove reviewer writes succeed with the intended lanes, and prove unknown canonical actors still fail closed without mutation.

items.title: Verify rollout artifact generation and process-fact contracts remain fail-closed
items.context: Run targeted build/smokes plus the process-fact contract guard. Confirm the writer emits a signed full-3x2 report, read/check accept it, and caller-supplied membership, verdict, quorum, or actor laundering remain forbidden.
